note: Checks run against the answer text. split: train / val / test (val + test kept at >= 1/3 of all tasks). reviewed: false until Isaac OKs the checks. The format may need adjusting to whatever SkillOpt-Sleep expects when it's set up.

tasks.intent: In the studio-platform repo, add the Phase 2 tables for art shows (shows, show_artworks) so the API can record which artworks went to a show and which sold there.

checks.description: Adds a new numbered migration instead of editing the first one
Every new table belongs to a studio
Money columns are whole cents

tasks.intent: Add the action that marks an artwork sold at a show to a client, so the artwork, the show record and the client's history all update together and the artist can undo it.

checks.description: Built as a registered action, not a one-off route
Marking sold waits for the artist's confirm tap
Never turns money into a decimal number

tasks.intent: Build the endpoint that receives a phone's queued offline changes and applies them, so a retry after a dropped connection never applies the same change twice.

checks.description: Uses each change's operation id to make retries safe
Checks the record version the phone edited from
Never takes the studio from what the phone sent

tasks.intent: Build the endpoint a device calls to fetch everything that changed since it last synced, including records that were deleted.

checks.description: Takes the device's last sync point
Uses the activity log's running number as the sync point
Sends deletions too, so other devices remove them

tasks.intent: Let each studio decide, per action, how much the AI assistant may do on its own: run it, ask first, always ask, or never. The assistant must not be able to get around this.

checks.description: A new numbered migration, not an edit to an applied one
The policy is stored per studio in the database
Enforced in studio-api's action runner, not in the prompt

checks.value: (?i)never (be )?lower|only raise|cannot be set to auto|can't be set to auto
checks.description: A studio can tighten an action's risk but never loosen always_confirm

tasks.intent: When the assistant wants to log a sale, show the artist one card to tap before anything is saved, with Undo afterwards.

checks.description: The proposal is held server-side until the tap
The tap confirms through studio-api with the user's session
Doesn't make a money action run without a tap
The result card can be undone

tasks.intent: Let the assistant turn a name like "Winter Park" or "the heron print" into the right show or sale, and ask which one when two match.

checks.description: Name resolution is an API route
Search only looks inside the signed-in studio
The new route is added to the cross-studio test suite

tasks.intent: Only send the model the tools that make sense for the app the artist is in, so the Show Tracker assistant can't reach invoice or client tools.

checks.description: Tools are generated from the action registry, not hand-written
The tool list is filtered per app
A test checks which tools are sent
